# Daemon Data

> Daemon Data publishes pay-per-record data APIs as Actors on Apify Store (https://apify.com/data_daemon). Each API reads a public website's own JSON endpoints or pages, returns structured records (JSON, CSV, Excel), charges only per record returned, and can be called over REST, from Python/Node.js, in n8n/Make/Zapier, or by an AI agent through MCP (`https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/<actor>`, header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`). Prices below are FREE-plan list prices checked on 2026-10-29.

## Data APIs

- [Welcome to the Jungle jobs](https://datadmon.github.io/actors/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper/): France-focused public WTTJ board jobs with descriptions, company profiles and only-new feeds. $0.80 per 1,000 jobs. Apify listing: https://apify.com/data_daemon/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper (plain text: https://apify.com/data_daemon/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper.md). MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper
- [IIMJobs jobs](https://datadmon.github.io/actors/iimjobs-jobs-scraper/): India MBA, finance, consulting and management jobs with full descriptions. $2.00 per 1,000 jobs. Apify listing: https://apify.com/data_daemon/iimjobs-jobs-scraper (plain text: https://apify.com/data_daemon/iimjobs-jobs-scraper.md). MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/iimjobs-jobs-scraper
- [Hirist jobs](https://datadmon.github.io/actors/hirist-jobs-scraper/): India IT and tech jobs with full descriptions, skills, salary when disclosed. $2.00 per 1,000 jobs. Apify listing: https://apify.com/data_daemon/hirist-jobs-scraper (plain text: https://apify.com/data_daemon/hirist-jobs-scraper.md). MCP: https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/hirist-jobs-scraper

## Guides

- [Dubai Land Department transactions as JSON: registered sold prices, weekly volumes and how to pull them](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/dubai-land-department-transactions-json/): What the Dubai Land Department transaction register contains (sales, off-plan, mortgages, gifts), how many transactions it records a week in October 2026, what the free portals give you, and how to get the register as JSON or CSV for $1 per 1,000 transactions.
- [How to export every IIMJobs and Hirist job as a daily feed](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/iimjobs-hirist-full-board-job-feed/): A full-board export of IIMJobs.com (management, finance, consulting) and Hirist.tech (tech) jobs for job aggregators and hiring trackers: every listing in a date window, only-new mode for daily runs, full descriptions and stable job IDs.
- [How to get new IIMJobs postings in Google Sheets every morning](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/iimjobs-new-jobs-google-sheets/): A daily feed of new IIMJobs.com jobs (MBA, finance, consulting, product) in Google Sheets and Slack, without duplicates: the only-new mode of the IIMJobs Jobs Scraper on Apify plus a ready n8n workflow.
- [India IPO GMP and subscription data as JSON: what the numbers mean and how to get them](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/india-ipo-gmp-subscription-data-json/): Grey market premium, QIB/NII/retail subscription, the IPO calendar and listing performance for Indian mainboard and SME IPOs: what each figure means, how often it changes, and how to pull all of it as JSON for $3 per 1,000 rows.
- [India job board data compared: IIMJobs, Hirist, Foundit and Instahyre as APIs](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/india-job-boards-data-compared/): Which Indian job board to pull data from for recruiters, aggregators and hiring-signal research: coverage, fields (salary, applicants, company profile), freshness and price per 1,000 jobs, measured in October 2026.
- [Oracle Recruiting Cloud career sites: how to export every job of an employer as JSON](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/oracle-recruiting-cloud-career-sites-export/): How to recognise an Oracle Recruiting Cloud (Oracle HCM) career site, how many jobs large employers list on them (Kotak 16,521, Marriott 13,286, JPMorgan 7,262 in October 2026), and how to export all of them, or only the new ones each day, as JSON for $2 per 1,000.
- [UK winding-up petitions and insolvency notices as a daily JSON feed from The Gazette](https://datadmon.github.io/guides/uk-winding-up-petitions-daily-feed/): How many winding-up petitions and administrations The Gazette publishes each week (October 2026), which notice-type codes to use, what the linked-data record adds (company number, registered office), and how to run a daily feed for about $3 a month.

## Docs

- [How to call any API](https://datadmon.github.io/docs/): REST run-sync call, Python, Node.js, n8n, MCP.

# Welcome to the Jungle jobs API (JSON) | Daemon Data | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper/

Welcome to the Jungle jobs API (JSON) | Daemon Data

Welcome to the Jungle Jobs Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns France-focused public WTTJ board jobs with descriptions, company profiles and only-new feeds as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.0008 per job with the default options ($0.80 per 1,000); no login to the source site, no proxy, no browser, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Welcome to the Jungle Jobs Scraper on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 23 Oct 2026
A public Python search matched 1,673 jobs on the France-focused board. Source searches expose at most 1,000 accessible hits each; narrow broad queries using country, company, contract or remote filters. Salary numbers are preserved as provided and may use inconsistent units.

Output fields
The most useful top-level fields with values from a real record; the full list is id, sourceId, dedupKey, url, applyUrl, title, slug, company, locations, offices, countryCodes, remoteMode, contractType, language, salary, experienceLevel, educationLevel, profession, sectors, postedAt, updatedAt, startDate, skills, tools, descriptionHtml, description, candidateProfile, recruitmentProcess, query, source, scrapedAt. Per-field notes and the OpenAPI definition are on the Apify API page.
FieldTypeExample
idstring"WEBNE_2q66Zp5"
dedupKeystring"wttj:WEBNE_2q66Zp5"
titlestring"Développeur Python - LLM/RAG H/F - Paris"
companyobject{"name": "Webnet", "slug": "webnet", "employeeCount": 200}
urlstring"https://www.welcometothejungle.com/en/companies/webnet/jobs/develo...
salaryobject{"minimum": 45, "maximum": 45, "currency": "EUR", "period": "yearly...
querystring"python"

Input and how to call it

A verified example input (it returned data on 2026-10-29):

{
  "queries": [
    "python"
  ],
  "countryCodes": [
    "FR"
  ],
  "contractTypes": [
    "FULL_TIME"
  ],
  "maxJobs": 20
}

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries": ["python"], "countryCodes": ["FR"], "contractTypes": ["FULL_TIME"], "maxJobs": 20}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper").call(run_input=...), full file python/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper.py. Node.js: node/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper.mjs. n8n: importable workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/welcome-to-the-jungle-jobs-scraper with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
queriesarrayOne public WTTJ search per keyword; jobs shared by several searches are delivered once. Default: python. An empty array runs no searches. Maximum 50 searches.
countryCodesarrayOptional two-letter office country codes, for example FR, ES or DE. Several values match any of them. Covers the France-focused public WTTJ board, including its jobs abroad; not the separate Otta/US/UK matching inventory.
locationsarrayOptional case-insensitive substring match on public office city, region or country. Accents are ignored. Several values match any of them. Applied locally within the source search window; use countryCodes to narrow the source search first.
contractTypesarrayOptional: FULL_TIME, TEMPORARY, INTERNSHIP, APPRENTICESHIP, FREELANCE, VIE, PART_TIME or OTHER. Several values match any of them; other filter groups are combined with AND.
remoteModesarrayOptional: fulltime (fully remote), partial (hybrid), punctual (occasional), no or unknown. Several values match any of them. This is the source designation, not a promise that applicants can work from any country.
languagesarrayOptional two-letter posting language codes such as fr or en. Several values match any of them.
companySlugsarrayOptional company URL slugs, for example webnet or elis-france. Several values match any of them. These must be slugs, not display names.
salaryCurrencystringOptional three-letter currency such as EUR. Filters on disclosed currency, not salary size. Salary numbers are preserved as provided; employers use inconsistent units.
postedWithinDaysintegerOptional 1-365 day posting window; 0 means no date filter. Jobs with unknown dates are excluded when enabled. Applied locally before fetching descriptions.
includeDescriptionbooleanRead each public job detail endpoint for description HTML, plain text, candidate profile, recruitment process and public company metadata. Off returns search listing data only. Same price per delivered job.
maxJobsPerQueryintegerMaximum delivered jobs per keyword, after filters and exclusions. Default 20. 0 means up to the source maximum of 1,000 accessible hits per search. Narrow broad searches with country/company/contract filters.
maxJobsintegerGlobal delivery cap across keywords. Default 20; 0 removes this cap but the per-keyword and 1,000-hit source windows still apply. Set a maximum charge in Apify for a spending cap.
skipJobIdsarrayOptional output id, sourceId or dedupKey values. Excluded jobs are skipped before detail requests and are not charged. Suitable for a database or spreadsheet containing jobs you already have.
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanRemember delivered job IDs in a persistent named key-value store. Later runs with the same state name return unseen jobs. Skipped jobs are not charged. First run is a baseline capped by maxJobs; later runs may fill older unseen backlog. Memory expires after 120 days and retains at most 50,000 IDs per feed.
stateNamestringOptional stable name for an only-new feed (maximum 120 characters). Same name shares memory across tasks in your account; avoid overlapping runs. Leave empty to derive a name from the search filters. Change the name for a fresh baseline.

Price
$0.0008 per job ($0.80 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.0008$0.80One delivered public WTTJ job: full description when enabled, company profile, offices, contract and remote labels, disclosed salary as provided.
Actor Start$0.001Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
Worked example: the input above, capped at 20 jobs, costs at most $0.017. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 6,250 jobs; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Separate Otta/US/UK personalized matching inventory; normalized salary benchmarks (raw source units vary); more than 1,000 hits per source search. The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Ready-made example pages
Saved inputs you can run with one click on Apify (Examples tab); each has its own page:
Welcome to the Jungle Python jobs in France as JSON: Export Python full-time jobs on the public France-focused WTTJ board, with full descriptions, company profiles, offices, remote mode and disclosed salary as provided. Bounded example: five jobs. {"queries": ["python"], "countryCodes": ["FR"], "contractTypes": ["FULL_TIME"], "maxJobs": 5}
Welcome to the Jungle fully remote Python jobs as JSON: Five public WTTJ jobs matching Python and the source fully remote label, with descriptions, company metadata and office countries. Coverage is the France-focused board, not the separate US/UK matching product. {"queries": ["python"], "remoteModes": ["fulltime"], "maxJobs": 5}
Webnet Python vacancies on WTTJ: company jobs API: Public Webnet Python jobs on Welcome to the Jungle, with full descriptions and company profile. Replace the company slug to monitor another employer on the France-focused public board. Up to five jobs. {"queries": ["python"], "companySlugs": ["webnet"], "maxJobs": 5}

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
Public WTTJ company job pagesBrowse and apply to public vacanciesManual reading; this Actor adds structured export and delivered-ID memory
Other WTTJ Actors on Apify StoreStructured data from the same sourceCompare coverage, description inclusion, only-new memory and price
Build your own API clientControl over public search and detail requestsYou maintain source configuration, filters, pagination and persistent job IDs

Published by Daemon Data (data_daemon on Apify Store). Prices, fields and example pages on this page were read from the live Apify listing on 2026-10-29; the listing is the canonical description of the Actor.

# IIMJobs job listings as JSON API | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/iimjobs-jobs-scraper/

IIMJobs job listings as JSON API

IIMJobs Jobs Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns India MBA, finance, consulting and management jobs with full descriptions as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.004 per job with the default options ($4.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site, no proxy, no browser, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data IIMJobs Jobs Scraper on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 18 Oct 2026
product manager matched 4,097 open IIMJobs listings and investment banking matched 652. On the first page of product manager, the median job already had about 170 applicants.

Who uses it, for what
You areWhat you get
Executive search and staffing firmsA daily list of new mid-senior openings by function, city and experience band, plus applicant counts, so you know which mandates are crowded before you pitch.
HR-tech products and job aggregatorsThe whole IIMJobs board as a daily feed (All jobs on the board + only-new mode), with stable job IDs (dedupKey), full JD text and de-duplication across runs, through an API you can call on a schedule.
Compensation and salary-benchmark teamsLPA ranges by role, experience band and city on every posting that discloses pay, with an explicit salaryHidden flag on the ones that don't.
B2B sales and lead generationCompanies hiring a CFO, finance controller or CHRO are about to buy finance or HR software. Each row includes the company name, domain, industry, size band and AmbitionBox profile.
Workforce and market analystsDemand for MBA, CA and CFA skills over time, hiring by city, and competition per role from applicant counts.
AI agents (MCP)Ask Claude or ChatGPT "VP finance roles in Mumbai posted this week" and let it call this Actor through Apify's MCP server.

Output fields
The most useful top-level fields with values from a real record; the full list is id, dedupKey, site, url, title, designation, company, recruiter, experienceMinYears, experienceMaxYears, salaryHidden, locations, remote, skills, mandatorySkills, industryIds, functionalAreaId, categoryId, premium, brandedJd, applicants, views, postedAt, descriptionHtml, description, query, scrapedAt, salaryMinLpa, salaryMaxLpa, otherLocation. Per-field notes and the OpenAPI definition are on the Apify API page.
FieldTypeExample
idnumber1739557
dedupKeystring"iimjobs:1739557"
sitestring"iimjobs"
urlstring"https://www.iimjobs.com/j/khatabook-senior-product-manager-1739557"
titlestring"Khatabook - Senior Product Manager"
designationstring"Product Manager"
companyobject{"name": "ADJ UTILITY APPS PRIVATE LIMITED", "domain": "khatabook.c...
recruiterobject{"name": null, "designation": "NA"}
experienceMinYearsnumber4
experienceMaxYearsnumber6
salaryHiddenbooleantrue

remotebooleanfalse
skillsarray["IT Product Management", "Online Product Management", "Consumer In...
mandatorySkillsarray["IT Product Management"]

Input and how to call it

A verified example input (it returned data on 2026-10-29):

{
  "queries": [
    "product manager"
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Bangalore",
    "Mumbai"
  ],
  "postedWithinDays": 7,
  "includeDescription": true,
  "maxJobsPerQuery": 50
}

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~iimjobs-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries": ["product manager"], "locations": ["Bangalore", "Mumbai"], "postedWithinDays": 7, "includeDescription": true, "maxJobsPerQuery": 50}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/iimjobs-jobs-scraper").call(run_input=...), full file python/iimjobs-jobs-scraper.py. Node.js: node/iimjobs-jobs-scraper.mjs. n8n: importable workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/iimjobs-jobs-scraper with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
queriesarrayOne IIMJobs search per keyword, e.g. product manager, chartered accountant, investment banking, CFO, brand manager. Use role or skill words; put cities in locations. Several specific keywords beat one broad one. A job found by two keywords is saved and charged once.
allJobsbooleanIgnore the keywords and deliver every job IIMJobs lists in the posting window: a full-board feed for job aggregators and market tracking. IIMJobs posts about 170 jobs a day (measured 26 Oct 2026). Uses postedWithinDays (the last 3 days when empty), locations, experience and maxJobs; the per-keyword cap does not apply. Combine with Only new jobs since the last run for a daily feed of every new job. You can also put * in the keywords.
locationsarrayOptional. Cities as IIMJobs lists them: Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Gurgaon, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Remote, Anywhere in India. Case-insensitive substring match on the job's listed locations; a single known city is also applied server-side for speed. Leave empty for all of India.
minExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range reaches at least this many years. Integer 0-40.
maxExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range starts at or below this many years. Integer 0-40.
postedWithinDaysintegerOnly jobs posted in the last N days. Integer 1-365, e.g. 1 with a daily schedule or 7 for a weekly report. Leave empty for all open jobs.
includeDescriptionbooleanOn (default): full description as HTML and plain text, plus the company profile. Adds $0.002 per job. Off: listing fields only, at half the price, which is enough for counting jobs or sizing a market.
maxJobsPerQueryintegerStop a keyword after this many new jobs (default 40). Cost: $0.002 per job plus $0.002 per full description, so 40 jobs with descriptions = $0.16. Raise it for full exports: product manager alone has about 4,000 open jobs.
maxJobsintegerHard cap on saved jobs for the whole run across all keywords (0 = no cap).
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanOn: deliver only jobs that an earlier run with the same stateName has not already delivered, and skip the rest without charging. If postedWithinDays is empty it is set to 3 so each run stays small. Off (default): return every matching job.
stateNamestringOptional name for this search's memory when onlyNewSinceLastRun is on, e.g. pm-bangalore-daily. Leave empty to derive it from the keywords, locations and experience filters. Use a new key to start over.
skipJobIdsarrayJob IDs you already have (the id field from earlier runs). They are skipped before any detail fetch and never charged. Large lists are fine.
sitestringKeep iimjobs (default) for management, finance, consulting and MBA jobs. Set hirist only for IT and tech jobs from Hirist.tech; the output format is the same, and the dedicated Hirist Jobs Scraper documents it.

Price
$0.002 per job ($2.00 per 1,000); $0.002 per job description ($2.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.002$2.00One job returned from search (title, company, salary, skills, locations, applicants, AmbitionBox rating).
Job description$0.002$2.00Full job description and company profile for one job (when includeDescription is on).
Worked example: the input above, capped at 50 jobs, costs at most $0.1. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 2,500 jobs; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

Scheduled change from 2026-11-02: job $0.002 ($2.00 per 1,000), actor start $0.001.

What it is not for
Tech roles (use Hirist); Naukri/LinkedIn/Indeed (not covered). The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Ready-made example pages
Saved inputs you can run with one click on Apify (Examples tab); each has its own page:

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to scrape IIMJobs?
$0.002 per job plus $0.002 per full description, so 100 jobs with descriptions cost $0.40 and a 50-jobs-a-day feed about $6 a month.
Is there an official IIMJobs API?
No public one. This Actor reads the JSON that the iimjobs.com website itself loads and exposes it as a REST API with schedules, webhooks and only-new-jobs runs.
Which roles does IIMJobs cover?
Management, consulting, finance, CA/CFA, sales, marketing, HR and MBA-track roles at Indian and global companies, mostly 2 to 25 years of experience.
Does it return the full job description?
Yes, as HTML and plain text, plus skills, applicant and view counts, salary in LPA when disclosed and the AmbitionBox company profile when one exists.
Why is recruiter.name null?
IIMJobs shows recruiter names only to logged-in users. The Actor keeps the recruiter's designation and does not work around the site's choice. Company name, domain and profile are always included.
IIMJobs vs Naukri: which should I scrape?
IIMJobs is curated mid-to-senior management, finance and consulting hiring. Naukri is all levels. For CXO, VP, CA/CFA and MBA roles, IIMJobs has far less noise.
Can I get IIMJobs and Hirist jobs together?
Yes. Hirist.tech Jobs Scraper uses the same output schema and the same onlyNewSinceLastRun mode, so one pipeline handles both boards.
Do I need a proxy or login?
No.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job

Other IIMJobs Actors on Apify StoreSimilar scraping of the same boardCompare fields (salary, AmbitionBox profile, only-new mode) and price per 1,000
Build your own scraperFull controlThe board's JSON endpoints change; you maintain pagination, de-duplication and scheduling

# Hirist tech job listings as JSON API | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/hirist-jobs-scraper/

Hirist tech job listings as JSON API

Hirist.tech Jobs Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns India IT and tech jobs with full descriptions, skills, salary when disclosed as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.004 per job with the default options ($4.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site, no proxy, no browser, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Hirist.tech Jobs Scraper on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 18 Oct 2026
data engineer matched 3,420 open Hirist jobs (239 posted in the last 7 days), python developer 1,884 and java 730. Most rows carry an AmbitionBox company profile, and the median python developer job had about 240 applicants.

Who uses it, for what
You areWhat you get
IT staffing and tech recruiting firmsEvery new Java, data or DevOps opening by city and experience band, with applicant counts, so you can see which roles are under-supplied.
HR-tech products and job aggregatorsThe whole Hirist board as a daily feed (All jobs on the board + only-new mode), with stable job IDs (dedupKey), full JD text and de-duplication across keywords and runs, on the same schema as our IIMJobs scraper: one integration covers India tech and management hiring.
Skills-demand and salary analystsCount skill tags across thousands of postings (mandatory vs nice-to-have) and track demand for Kafka, Snowflake, GenAI or SAP by city and seniority.
B2B sales (tech-stack intent)A company hiring three Snowflake engineers is a Snowflake account. Rows include the company name, domain, industry, size band, AmbitionBox profile and skills.
Job-alert and career productsFresh roles from the last 24 hours, filtered by experience, for alert bots and newsletters.
AI agents (MCP)Ask Claude or ChatGPT for "remote senior Python roles posted this week" and let it call this Actor through Apify's MCP server.

Input and how to call it

A verified example input (it returned data on 2026-10-29):

{
  "queries": [
    "python developer"
  ],
  "locations": [
    "Bangalore"
  ],
  "postedWithinDays": 7,
  "includeDescription": true,
  "maxJobsPerQuery": 50
}

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~hirist-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"queries": ["python developer"], "locations": ["Bangalore"], "postedWithinDays": 7, "includeDescription": true, "maxJobsPerQuery": 50}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/hirist-jobs-scraper").call(run_input=...), full file python/hirist-jobs-scraper.py. Node.js: node/hirist-jobs-scraper.mjs. n8n: importable workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/hirist-jobs-scraper with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
queriesarrayOne Hirist.tech search per keyword, e.g. python developer, data engineer, devops, react native, sap abap. Use role or skill words; put cities in locations. Several specific keywords beat one broad one. A job found by two keywords is saved and charged once.
allJobsbooleanIgnore the keywords and deliver every job Hirist lists in the posting window: a full-board feed for job aggregators and market tracking. Hirist posts about 140 jobs a day (measured 26 Oct 2026). Uses postedWithinDays (the last 3 days when empty), locations, experience and maxJobs; the per-keyword cap does not apply. Combine with Only new jobs since the last run for a daily feed of every new job. You can also put * in the keywords.
locationsarrayOptional. Cities as Hirist lists them: Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Gurgaon, Noida, Mumbai, Remote, Anywhere in India. Case-insensitive substring match on the job's listed locations; a single known city is also applied server-side for speed. Leave empty for all of India.
minExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range reaches at least this many years. Integer 0-40.
maxExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range starts at or below this many years. Integer 0-40.
postedWithinDaysintegerOnly jobs posted in the last N days. Integer 1-365, e.g. 1 with a daily schedule or 7 for a weekly report. Leave empty for all open jobs.
includeDescriptionbooleanOn (default): full, untruncated description as HTML and plain text, plus the company profile. Adds $0.002 per job. Off: listing fields only, at half the price, which is enough for counting jobs or sizing a market.
maxJobsPerQueryintegerStop a keyword after this many new jobs (default 40). Cost: $0.002 per job plus $0.002 per full description, so 40 jobs with descriptions = $0.16. Raise it for full exports: data engineer alone has about 3,400 open jobs.
maxJobsintegerHard cap on saved jobs for the whole run across all keywords (0 = no cap).
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanOn: deliver only jobs that an earlier run with the same stateName has not already delivered, and skip the rest without charging. If postedWithinDays is empty it is set to 3 so each run stays small. Off (default): return every matching job.
stateNamestringOptional name for this search's memory when onlyNewSinceLastRun is on, e.g. python-bangalore-daily. Leave empty to derive it from the keywords, locations and experience filters. Use a new key to start over.
skipJobIdsarrayJob IDs you already have (the id field from earlier runs). They are skipped before any detail fetch and never charged. Large lists are fine.
sitestringKeep hirist (default) for IT and tech jobs. Set iimjobs only for management, finance and MBA jobs from IIMJobs.com; the output format is the same, and the dedicated IIMJobs Jobs Scraper documents it.

Price
$0.002 per job ($2.00 per 1,000); $0.002 per job description ($2.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.002$2.00One job returned from search (title, company, salary, skills, locations, applicants, AmbitionBox rating).
Job description$0.002$2.00Full job description and company profile for one job (when includeDescription is on).
Worked example: the input above, capped at 50 jobs, costs at most $0.1. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 2,500 jobs; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

Scheduled change from 2026-11-02: job $0.002 ($2.00 per 1,000), actor start $0.001.

What it is not for
Non-tech roles (use IIMJobs). The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to scrape Hirist jobs?
$0.002 per job plus $0.002 per full description, so 100 jobs with descriptions cost $0.40 and a 34-jobs-a-day feed about $4 a month.
Is there a Hirist API?
Not a public one. This Actor reads the JSON the hirist.tech site itself loads and exposes it as a REST API with schedules, webhooks and only-new-jobs runs.
Is Hirist.tech real or fake?
Hirist.tech is a legitimate Indian tech job board owned by Info Edge, the Naukri group. Every row links to the original posting, so you can verify it.
Can I filter by city and experience?
Yes: locations, minExperience, maxExperience and postedWithinDays. A single city is passed to Hirist's own search; several cities are matched on our side.
Does it return the full job description?
Yes, as HTML and plain text, untruncated, plus skills, applicant and view counts, salary in LPA when shown and the AmbitionBox company profile when one exists.
Why is recruiter.name null?
Hirist shows recruiter names only to logged-in users. The Actor keeps the recruiter's designation and does not work around the site's choice. Company name, domain and profile are always included.
Hirist vs Naukri?
Hirist is tech-only and every posting carries skill tags and an experience band, which makes it cleaner for skills analytics. Naukri is broader and noisier.
Can I get Hirist and IIMJobs jobs together?
Yes. IIMJobs Jobs Scraper uses the same output schema and the same onlyNewSinceLastRun mode, so one pipeline handles both boards.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
careerSiteUrlsarrayOne or more Oracle Recruiting Cloud (Oracle HCM) career site URLs. They look like https://{tenant}.fa.{region}.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/{siteNumber}; any page of the site works, including a single job URL. Example: JPMorgan Chase = https://jpmc.fa.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1001. To find a company's site, web-search: site:oraclecloud.com CandidateExperience "". Taleo and Workday sites are not supported.
keywordstringOptional. Searched the way the career site's own search box does, e.g. data, nurse, sales manager. Leave empty to export every open job.
locationstringOptional country, state or city, e.g. India, United Kingdom, London, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Countries always work. States and cities are resolved through the site's own location filter; if the site does not list the place, jobs are matched on their location text instead and only matching jobs are delivered and charged. The run log lists the locations a site offers.
postedWithinDaysintegerOnly jobs posted recently. Integer 1-30; Oracle supports two buckets, so 1-7 means the last 7 days and 8-30 the last 30 days. Leave empty for all open jobs.
workplaceTypesarrayOptional: only remote, hybrid or on-site jobs. Works only on career sites that tag workplace type; some tag every job on-site (Oracle's own site does), and then Remote returns 0 jobs.
includeDetailsbooleanOn (default): full description, qualifications, responsibilities, skills and the employer's custom fields. Adds $0.002 per job. Off: list fields only, at half the price.
maxJobsPerSiteintegerStop after this many jobs per career site (default 50, about $0.20 with details at FREE prices). Set 0 to export the whole site; large employers list 2,000-13,000 open jobs.
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanDeliver only jobs that an earlier run with the same search (or the same State key) has not already delivered. Skipped jobs are not charged. Made for daily schedules: the Actor remembers delivered job IDs in a key-value store named oracle-hcm-jobs-state in your account. When this is on and Posted within is empty, the last 7 days are searched.
stateNamestringOptional name for this saved search's memory when Only new jobs is on, e.g. jpmc-india. Leave empty to derive it from the career site URLs, keyword, location and workplace types. Use a new key to start over.
skipJobIdsarrayOptional requisition IDs to leave out, e.g. the id values from an earlier run. Skipped jobs are not charged. Large lists are fine.
maxJobsintegerHard cap for the whole run across all sites (0 = no cap).

Price
$0.002 per job ($2.00 per 1,000); $0.002 per job details ($2.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.002$2.00One requisition from an Oracle Cloud HCM career site.
Job details$0.002$2.00Full description, qualifications, responsibilities and flex fields for one requisition (when includeDetails is on).

Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse, Lever, SuccessFactors sites. The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to scrape an Oracle career site?
$0.002 per job plus $0.002 per full detail record. A 500-job site with details costs $2.00; the same site without details costs $1.00.
Does Oracle Recruiting Cloud have a public API for job postings?
The documented Oracle HCM REST API needs customer credentials. Public career sites load their jobs from an unauthenticated candidate-experience endpoint (/hcmRestApi/resources/latest/recruitingCEJobRequisitions), which is what this Actor reads, with the same filters the careers page uses. The three endpoints, their parameters and the silent wrong-site fallback are documented in Oracle Recruiting Cloud jobs API: the public JSON endpoints behind every Oracle HCM career site.
What is the difference between Oracle HCM, Oracle Fusion and Oracle Recruiting Cloud?
Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM is the suite. Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) is its recruiting module. The public careers page is called Candidate Experience, which is why the URLs contain CandidateExperience.
Does it read Taleo or Workday sites?
No. Taleo is Oracle's older, separate ATS and Workday is a different vendor. This Actor covers Oracle Recruiting Cloud (oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience) sites only. Other hosts are skipped with a warning, not an error.
Why do I see several sites (CX_1, CX_1001, CX_45001) for one employer?
Tenants keep backup, campus and alumni sites. Use the one in the table above, or the one your browser shows on the employer's careers page. Oracle's own retired CX_1 still answers, but the live site is CX_45001.
Can I filter by city?
Yes. Cities and states are matched against the site's own location filter (for example LONDON, United Kingdom on JPMorgan Chase or Dubai, United Arab Emirates on Marriott). If a site only lists states, as Kotak does, the Actor matches the city against each job's location text instead, and only matching jobs are charged.
Which companies use Oracle Cloud HCM career sites?
Thousands of large employers: banks, hospitals, universities, manufacturers, retailers, hotel groups and governments. Their career pages live under oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/.
Do I need a proxy or login?
No.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
The employer's own career siteBrowse and applyOne employer at a time, no export
Multi-ATS job APIs (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and others)Several ATS platforms in one productUsually higher price per 1,000; check whether Oracle Recruiting Cloud is actually covered
Open-source ATS crawlersFreeYou host, schedule and maintain them

# India IPO GMP & subscription data API (JSON) | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/india-ipo-tracker/

India IPO GMP & subscription data API (JSON)

India IPO Tracker API is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns live IPO GMP, QIB/NII/retail subscription, calendar, listing data as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.003 per ipo report row with the default options ($3.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site, no proxy, no browser, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data India IPO Tracker API on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 18 Oct 2026
A live GMP report had about 50 rows (every upcoming, open and recently listed IPO), the calendar about 30, and the year-to-date subscription, IPO-list and listing-performance reports about 280 to 300 rows each. The default run (GMP plus calendar, about 80 rows) costs about $0.25 and finishes in under 30 seconds.

Why teams use it
Two sources joined for you. GMP and subscription come from different public IPO reports. Every record carries the same stable slug (e.g. paras-healthcare-ipo), so you can join reports without fuzzy name matching.
Mainboard and SME in one feed, with ISIN, BSE scrip code and NSE symbol on subscription, IPO-list and listing-performance rows for joining to your security master.
Cheap to poll. Plain HTTP, no browser: a GMP refresh costs about 15 cents.
Never fails on input. Unknown options are ignored with a warning and the run still succeeds, so schedules and webhooks keep working.
No contract. Pay per row, cancel by stopping the schedule.

Output fields
The most useful top-level fields with values from a real record; the full list is reportType, source, sourceReportId, ipoName, slug, url, category, status, statusLabel, gmp, gmpPercent, gmpText, rating, subscriptionText, issuePrice, issueSizeCr, lotSize, priceToEarnings, openDate, closeDate, allotmentDate, listingDate, updatedOn, anchorInvestors, fields, meta, scrapedAt, date, dateLabel, opening, closing, allotment, refundUnblock, listing, holiday, statusText, exchange, listingPrice, listingGainPercent, qibX, sNiiX, bNiiX, niiX, retailX, employeeX, totalX, applications, subscriptionAsOn, isin, bseScripCode, nseSymbol, shareholderX, listingAt, listingOpenPrice, listingOpenGainPercent, listingClosePrice, currentPriceBse, currentPriceNse, currentGainPercent, symbol, subscriptionX, estimatedListingPrice, listingDayClosePrice, closingGainPercent, lastTradedPrice, lastTradedGainPercent, listingVsEstimate, lastUpdated. Per-field notes and the OpenAPI definition are on the Apify API page.

Input and how to call it

A verified example input (it returned data on 2026-10-29):

{
  "reports": [
    "gmp",
    "subscription"
  ],
  "category": "all"
}

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~india-ipo-tracker/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"reports": ["gmp", "subscription"], "category": "all"}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/india-ipo-tracker").call(run_input=...), full file python/india-ipo-tracker.py. Node.js: node/india-ipo-tracker.mjs. n8n: importable workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/india-ipo-tracker with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
reportsarrayWhich IPO datasets to extract. Each produces its own reportType records. Default: live GMP (gmp) plus the IPO event calendar (calendar), about 80 rows, about $0.25 at $0.003 per row. Add subscription for QIB/NII/Retail multiples (every IPO of the current calendar year so far, about 300 rows) and currentIpos for status, price band, lot size and dates (about 300 rows). gmpPerformance compares the last GMP with the actual listing price (about 280 rows per year).
categorystringMainboard IPOs, SME IPOs, or both (all). Applies to every report except the event calendar.
yearintegerCalendar year (YYYY, 2000 to next year) for the year-scoped reports. Leave empty for the current year (recommended). Only gmpPerformance has full history for past years (2025 returns about 380 rows); ipoList, subscription, listingPerformance and currentIpos return only a handful of rows for past years because the sources publish them for the current calendar year. gmp and calendar are always live and ignore this field. Invalid values are ignored with a warning, the run does not fail.
includeIpoDetailsbooleanAlso fetch each IPO's detail page (price band, lot size, timetable, reservation, anchor investors, financials, objects of the issue). Emits one extra ipoDetail record per IPO, charged $0.015 per detail page on top of the rows.
maxItemsintegerStop after this many records (0 = no limit). Each record costs $0.003; each IPO detail page $0.015.

Price
$0.003 per ipo report row ($3.00 per 1,000); $0.015 per ipo detail page ($15.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
IPO report row$0.003$3.00One record from any IPO report (current IPOs, GMP, subscription, list, listing performance, GMP performance, calendar).
IPO detail page$0.015$15.00One full IPO detail record (price band, lot size, timetable, reservation, anchors, financials, objects).
Worked example: the input above, capped at 50 ipo report rows, costs at most $0.15. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 1,666 ipo report rows; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Non-Indian IPOs; secondary-market prices (use Tickertape). The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to get Indian IPO GMP and subscription data?
The default run (live GMP + calendar, about 80 rows) costs about $0.25 at $0.003 per row. A GMP-only poll is about $0.15. Full IPO detail pages cost $0.015 per IPO.
How often is the data updated?
Every run reads the sources live. Schedule it every 30 minutes during IPO bidding hours for a near-real-time feed.
Does it cover SME IPOs?
Yes. Set category to sme, mainboard or all. Every record carries category so you can also filter afterwards.
Can I get past years?
Only for gmpPerformance (GMP vs listing price), which has full history per calendar year through the year field. The other year-scoped reports are published by the sources for the current calendar year only, so past years return just a few rows.
Is there an IPO GMP API?
There is no official one: GMP is an unofficial grey-market indicator, and BSE and NSE do not publish it. This Actor works as an IPO GMP API: call it through the Apify API (run-sync-get-dataset-items returns the rows in the response), from Python or Node.js, or from n8n, Make, Zapier or an AI agent, and get live GMP, subscription, calendar and listing results as JSON.
How accurate is IPO GMP?
In 2026 the last GMP before listing missed the actual listing gain by 8.6 percentage points on average (7.0 for mainboard, 9.6 for SME IPOs), and 69% of IPOs listed within 10 points of their GMP. See "How accurate is IPO GMP?" above; the gmpPerformance report lets you recompute it for any year.
Do I need a proxy or login?
No. The sources answer plain HTTP requests, so runs finish in seconds.
What happens if a source is down?
Reports that cannot be fetched are logged and skipped; the run still succeeds with whatever was collected. Only when every requested report is unreachable and nothing was collected does the run fail with a clear message, so your webhook can alert you.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
Broker APIs (for example Upstox)Official IPO calendar and some subscription figuresNo grey market premium; one broker's view
IPO tracking websitesGMP and subscription pages for peopleNo JSON, no stable key across reports, no schedule
BSE and NSE websitesOfficial bid data while an issue is openNo GMP; bot protection; no history joined to listing results

# NSE/BSE stock fundamentals API (Tickertape) | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/tickertape-stocks-scraper/

NSE/BSE stock fundamentals API (Tickertape)

Indian Stock Market API is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns NSE/BSE index constituents, ratio screener, full stock profiles as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.02 per stock profile with the default options ($20.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site, no proxy, no browser, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Indian Stock Market API on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 18 Oct 2026
Tickertape listed 77 indices; a NIFTY 500 constituent run returns 500 rows for $1, and a full profile carries 10 years of statements plus the shareholding history. On 21 Oct 2026 five full profiles (Reliance, TCS, Infosys, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank) took 17 seconds.

Why teams use it
The whole stock page in one record. Statement lines come with readable names (Total Revenue, Net Income, EPS, Free Cash Flow), not just codes.
Shareholding as a trend. Six quarters of promoter, pledged, FII, DII, MF, insurance and retail percentages: compare quarters to spot FII exits or rising promoter pledges.
Screener plus enrichment. Filter on market cap, P/E, P/B, dividend yield, ROE, ROCE, debt/equity, 1-week to 1-year returns, beta, promoter pledge and FII/DII holding, then pull the full profile for every match in the same run.
Never a failed run on a typo. An unknown index name, a stock that does not exist or a screener with no matches finishes successfully with 0 rows and a status message that says why, so schedules and webhooks keep working.
Fast. Index and screener rows arrive in seconds; a 50-stock full-profile run finishes in about a minute. Plain HTTP, no browser.
From an AI assistant:* add the MCP connector https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/tickertape-stocks-scraper in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
modestringstocks (default): full profiles for the tickers in stocks. index: all constituents of the index in indexSid. screener: rows matching screenerMatch. Set mode explicitly when you use indexSid or screenerMatch; when it is empty, the mode follows whichever of stocks, screenerMatch or indexSid you filled in.
stocksarrayNSE tickers, company names or Tickertape URLs, e.g. RELIANCE, TCS, Infosys, https://www.tickertape.in/stocks/hdfc-bank-HDBK. Each full profile costs $0.02. Leave empty when you use index or screener mode.
indexSidstringFor index mode. Any index Tickertape lists (77 on 2026-10-18), by name or Tickertape id: NIFTY 50, NIFTY NEXT 50, NIFTY 100, NIFTY 200, NIFTY 500, NIFTY BANK, NIFTY IT, NIFTY AUTO, NIFTY FMCG, NIFTY PHARMA, NIFTY METAL, NIFTY REALTY, NIFTY PSU BANK, NIFTY FIN SERVICE, NIFTY MIDCAP 100, NIFTY MIDCAP 150, NIFTY SMALLCAP 100, NIFTY SMALLCAP 250, SENSEX, BSE 500, or ids such as .NSEI, .NN50, .NIFTYIT. Defaults to NIFTY 50. Each row costs $0.002 (or $0.02 with fullProfile).
screenerMatchobjectFor screener mode. Example, large caps with P/E under 20 and ROE over 15%: {"mrktCapf": {"g": 5000}, "apef": {"l": 20}, "roe": {"g": 15}} (g = greater than, l = less than). Field codes: mrktCapf market cap in ₹ crore, apef P/E, pbr P/B, divYield dividend yield %, roe, roce, dbtEqt debt/equity, pr1w 1-week return %, 4wpct 1-month, 26wpct 6-month, 52wpct 1-year return %, beta, promShrPled pledged promoter %, forInstHldng FII %, domInstHldng DII %, sector (e.g. {"sector": "Energy"}). Each row costs $0.002.
screenerSortBystringField code to sort screener results by (default mrktCapf). The sort field is always included in the output rows.
screenerSortDescbooleanSort screener results descending (default) or ascending.
screenerFieldsarrayAdditional Tickertape ratio codes to return per screener row. Every row already carries: subindustry, mrktCapf, lastPrice, apef, pbr, divYield, roe, roce, dbtEqt, pr1w, 4wpct, 26wpct, 52wpct, 52wHigh, 52wLow, beta, promShrPled, forInstHldng, domInstHldng.
fullProfilebooleanFetch the complete profile for every stock ($0.02 each): quote, key ratios, scorecard, 10-year income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, quarterly results, shareholding history, dividends, corporate actions, announcements, analyst forecasts, mutual-fund holders, peers and checklist. Off = lightweight rows ($0.002 each) with price, market cap, P/E, P/B and dividend yield. Defaults to on in stocks mode and off in index / screener mode.
maxItemsintegerStop after this many records (0 = no limit). Useful to cap the cost of a NIFTY 500 or screener run.

Price
$0.02 per stock profile ($20.00 per 1,000); $0.002 per quote / screener row ($2.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to get Indian stock fundamentals?
$0.02 per full stock profile (10 years of statements, quarterly results, shareholding history, dividends, forecasts, peers) and $0.002 per lightweight index or screener row. All of NIFTY 50 with full profiles costs $1.
Which indices are supported?
Any of the 77 indices Tickertape publishes, by name, Tickertape id or index URL: NIFTY 50, NIFTY NEXT 50, NIFTY 100, NIFTY 200, NIFTY 500, NIFTY BANK, NIFTY IT, NIFTY AUTO, NIFTY FMCG, NIFTY PHARMA, NIFTY METAL, NIFTY REALTY, NIFTY PSU BANK, NIFTY FIN SERVICE, NIFTY MIDCAP 100 / 150, NIFTY SMALLCAP 100 / 250, SENSEX, BSE 500 and the other NSE and BSE sector and strategy indices.
What do index rows contain?
Ticker, company name, sector, last price, 1-day change, market cap (₹ crore), P/E, P/B, dividend yield, ROE, 52-week high and low, and free float. Switch on fullProfile for statements, shareholding and forecasts.
Can I run a screener?
Yes. Pass any Tickertape filter object such as {"mrktCapf": {"g": 5000}, "apef": {"l": 20}}. A filter with no matches finishes successfully with 0 rows and a status message.
Does Tickertape have a public API for NSE stock fundamentals?
Tickertape does not publish a documented public API. This Actor reads the data that Tickertape's public stock pages load, without a login, and returns it as JSON: quotes, key ratios, scorecard and 10 years of financial statements for NSE and BSE stocks, plus index member lists. Call it through the Apify API, from Python or Node.js, or from an AI agent, like any Indian stock market API.
Do I need a proxy or login?
No.

# Dubai Land Department transactions as JSON API | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/dubai-property-transactions/

Dubai Land Department transactions as JSON API

Dubai DLD Property Transactions API is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns Dubai Land Department sales, mortgages and gifts with AED value and price/sqm as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.001 per transaction with the default options ($1.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site, no proxy, no browser, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Dubai DLD Property Transactions API on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 18 Oct 2026
In the week to 18 Oct 2026 the register recorded about 4,100 transactions: 2,600 sales (1,650 off-plan, 950 ready), 1,300 mortgages and 160 gifts; about 2,500 of the sales were residential and 220 were land plots. On 21 Oct 2026 the last-24-hours example returned 1,000 transactions in 6 seconds.

Why teams use it
Registered prices, not asking prices. Listing portals show what sellers want; DLD shows what buyers actually paid.
Complete. A typical week has 3,000–6,000 transactions; the Actor pages through all of them, 500 at a time.
Analysis-ready. Numeric AED values and areas, ISO dates, boolean off-plan/freehold flags, pricePerSqmAed precomputed, optional Arabic names.
Pre-registration vs completed sale. The procedure field separates developer pre-registrations (Sell - Pre registration) from completed sales (Sale, Delayed Sell), and mortgage registrations from modifications.
Open data, no personal data. Published by the Dubai Land Department for reuse; no owner names or contacts are included.
From an AI assistant:* add the MCP connector https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/dubai-property-transactions in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

One HTTP call starts a run, waits for it and returns the records (token from console.apify.com):

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~dubai-property-transactions/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"transactionGroup": "sales", "maxItems": 500}'

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/dubai-property-transactions").call(run_input=...), full file python/dubai-property-transactions.py. Node.js: node/dubai-property-transactions.mjs. n8n: importable workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/dubai-property-transactions with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
fromDatestringStart of the transaction date range, YYYY-MM-DD (DD/MM/YYYY also accepted). Leave empty to use Days back instead, so a scheduled run never needs a date edit. An invalid date is ignored with a warning.
toDatestringEnd of the transaction date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).
daysBackintegerUsed when From date is empty: fetch the last N days up to To date (or today). Default 7, minimum 1, maximum 365; values outside that range are clamped. Set 1 for a daily scheduled feed. All transactions run about 600 rows ($0.60) per working day and 4,000 ($4) per week; DLD registers nothing on weekends, so a weekend run returns 0 rows and costs nothing.
transactionGroupstringFilter by DLD transaction group: all, sales, mortgages or gifts. Weekly volume in Oct 2026: all about 4,000 rows ($4.00), sales about 2,600 ($2.60), mortgages about 1,300 ($1.30), gifts about 160 ($0.16).
offPlanstringOff-plan (developer pre-registration) vs completed properties: all, offplan or ready. Of about 2,600 weekly sales, roughly 1,650 are off-plan and 950 ready.
freeholdstringFreehold vs non-freehold tenure: all, freehold or nonfreehold.
usagestringProperty usage: all, residential or commercial. Of about 2,600 weekly sales, roughly 2,500 are residential and 70 commercial.
propertyTypestringProperty type: all, unit (apartments and villa units), building or land. Land plots are about 220 of the 2,600 weekly sales.
includeArabicbooleanAdd an arabic object with the Arabic names for area, project, procedure etc. No extra charge.
maxItemsintegerStop after this many transactions (0 = all in range). Each transaction costs $0.001, so the default 200 = $0.20 and 2,000 = $2.00. A typical week has 3,000-6,000 transactions.
sortstringSort order by DLD transaction number: TRANSACTION_NUMBER_ASC or TRANSACTION_NUMBER_DESC. Matters only when maxItems cuts the range short.
areaIdstringAdvanced: DLD internal area id, passed through to the gateway. The transactions feed returns areaId 0 on every row and, as of October 2026, 0 rows for any id sent here, so ids cannot be looked up from the output and this filter is not usable. Leave empty and filter on the area name in the results.

Price
$0.001 per transaction ($1.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Transaction$0.001$1.00One Dubai Land Department transaction record.
Worked example: the input above, capped at 500 transactions, costs at most $0.5. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 5,000 transactions; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Listings/asking prices; rental contracts; other emirates. The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to get Dubai property transactions?
$0.001 per transaction. A full week of all DLD transactions (about 4,100 rows) costs about $4.10; a week of sales alone about $2.60.
Is this the official DLD data?
Yes. It reads the Dubai Land Department's open-data transactions service, the same register that paid DLD data products resell.
Can I filter by area or off-plan?
Off-plan vs ready, sales / mortgages / gifts, freehold, usage and property type are input filters. For areas, filter the output on the area and project names: DLD's area-id parameter returns no rows and areaId is 0 on every row, so that field is hidden under Advanced.
Does it include price per square metre?
Yes, pricePerSqmAed is computed from the transaction value and the actual area.
Can I run it every day without editing dates?
Yes. Leave fromDate empty and set daysBack to 1; the window moves with the run date.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
Dubai Pulse open-data portalOfficial downloads by handManual extracts, cleaning needed, no schedule
DXB Interact dashboardOfficial charts and lookupsNot a data feed
Paid DLD data productsCleaned data with supportSubscriptions; the register itself is open data

# UK Gazette insolvency notices as JSON feed | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/uk-gazette-insolvency-notices/

UK Gazette insolvency notices as JSON feed

UK Gazette Insolvency Notices Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns winding-up petitions, administrations, liquidations from The Gazette as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.005 per notice with the default options ($5.00 per 1,000); no login to the source site, no proxy, no browser, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data UK Gazette Insolvency Notices Scraper on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 17 Oct 2026
In the week of 11 to 17 Oct 2026 The Gazette published 138 winding-up petitions and 43 administration appointments; HMRC presented 56% of the 620 petitions of the prior 30 days. On 21 Oct 2026 the 48-hour corporate-insolvency example returned 100 notices with 98 structured records.

Why teams use it
Structured, joinable fields. Company number for Companies House, postcode, nature of business, petitioner, court, case number, practitioner firm. No copy-pasting notice text.
Earlier than Companies House. Petitions are advertised before the hearing; the company record often changes weeks later.
Any notice type, any date range. Petitions, winding-up orders, administrations, liquidator appointments, creditors' meetings, bankruptcy orders, or personal insolvency.
Built for schedules. publishedWithinDays gives a rolling window, onlyNewSinceLastRun delivers only notices you have not received before, and skipped notices are never charged.
Open Government Licence. Gazette notices are Crown copyright under OGL v3.0; company-level data can be reused with attribution (see "Licence and personal data" below).
From an AI assistant:* add the MCP connector https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/uk-gazette-insolvency-notices in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
servicestringWhich Gazette search to query. Default insolvency.
noticeTypesarrayOptional Gazette notice type codes (verified Oct 2026): 2450 petitions to wind up (companies), 2451 petitions to wind up (partnerships), 2452 winding-up orders, 2441 resolutions for winding up, 2432 and 2443 appointment of liquidators, 2442 meetings of creditors, 2433 notices to creditors, 2410 appointment of administrators, 2503 bankruptcy orders. Default is petitions and administrations (2450, 2410); pass an empty list for every type in the section.
categoryCodestringOptional Gazette category code, e.g. G205000000 corporate insolvency, G206000000 personal insolvency, G205010000 companies.
textstringOptional free-text search, e.g. Revenue and Customs for HMRC petitions, a company name, a town, or an insolvency practitioner firm.
publishedWithinDaysintegerRelative date window for schedules: only notices published in the last N days, counted back from today (UTC). 1 = since yesterday, 7 = the last week. Ignored when Published from is set. Combine with Only new notices for a daily feed.
startPublishDatestringYYYY-MM-DD. Only notices published on or after this date. Leave empty to use Published within the last N days instead.
endPublishDatestringYYYY-MM-DD. Only notices published on or before this date.
sortBystringSort order. Default latest-date.
includeLinkedDatabooleanFetch each notice's linked-data record and add it as top-level fields: company number, registered office and trading address, postcode, nature of business, petitioner (and an HMRC flag), court and case number, hearing, petition, appointment and resolution dates, and the insolvency practitioner's name, firm, IP number and contact details. Charged as one extra notice-details event per notice where the record was retrieved. Default on.
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanDeliver only notices that an earlier run with the same search (or the same State key) has not already delivered. Skipped notices are not charged. Delivered notice ids are remembered for 180 days in a key-value store named uk-gazette-notices-state in your account. Made for daily schedules.
stateNamestringOptional name for this saved search's memory when Only new notices is on. Leave empty to derive it from the section, notice types, category and search text. Use a different key to track several feeds separately.
maxItemsintegerStop after this many notices have been delivered. Default 40, about $0.20 with structured details at FREE prices.

Price
$0.002 per notice ($2.00 per 1,000); $0.003 per notice details ($3.00 per 1,000). List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Notice$0.002$2.00One Gazette notice from the feed.
Notice details$0.003$3.00Structured linked-data record for one notice: company number, addresses, court, case, dates, practitioners.
Worked example: the input above, capped at 40 notices, costs at most $0.08. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 2,500 notices; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Companies House filings; Scottish/Irish court records outside The Gazette. The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to monitor UK winding-up petitions?
$0.002 per notice plus $0.003 for the structured details record. About 140 petitions a week means roughly $3 a month for a daily feed with details.
Does it return only new notices?
Yes. Turn on onlyNewSinceLastRun; each run delivers only notices that earlier runs with the same search have not delivered, and the skipped ones are free.
Can I reuse the data commercially?
Gazette notices are Crown copyright under the Open Government Licence v3.0, so company-level data can be reused with attribution. Personal data is excluded from the licence.
Which notice types are supported?
Any Gazette notice type code. The common corporate ones are 2450 petitions to wind up, 2452 winding-up orders, 2410 appointment of administrators, 2441 resolutions for winding up, 2432 and 2443 appointment of liquidators, 2442 meetings of creditors and 2433 notices to creditors.
Is there a data feed or API for UK winding-up petitions?
The Gazette publishes every insolvency notice in a public feed, with a structured record for each notice, but you have to page the feed, fetch each record and flatten it yourself. This Actor does that and returns one row per notice as JSON, CSV or Excel: company name and number, court and case number, petitioner, petition and hearing dates, practitioners and addresses. With Only new notices and a daily schedule it becomes a winding-up petitions data feed that delivers, and charges for, new notices only.
Do I need a proxy or login?
No. If The Gazette rate-limits the structured-data requests, the Actor switches to Apify datacenter proxy by itself.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
The Gazette website and its paid data serviceOfficial notices; a subscription data service for businessManual reading, or a subscription contract
Companies House APIOfficial company status, freeChanges appear weeks after the petition is advertised
Other Gazette Actors on Apify StoreSame noticesCompare linked-data fields (company number, addresses) and only-new mode

curl -X POST "https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/data_daemon~foundit-jobs-scraper/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \

Python: ApifyClient(token).actor("data_daemon/foundit-jobs-scraper").call(run_input=...), full file python/foundit-jobs-scraper.py. Node.js: node/foundit-jobs-scraper.mjs. n8n: importable workflow.
AI assistant (MCP): add the remote server https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=data_daemon/foundit-jobs-scraper with header Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or VS Code and ask for the data in plain words.

All input fields
FieldTypeMeaning
queriesarrayOne foundit.in search per keyword, e.g. data analyst, java developer, sales manager, chartered accountant, nurse. Use role or skill words; put cities in locations. A job found by two keywords is saved and charged once. Leave the list with one item for a quick first run.
allJobsbooleanIgnore the keywords and deliver every job foundit lists in the posting window: a full-board feed for job aggregators and labour-market tracking. foundit posts about 2,800 jobs a day (2,815 in the last day on 26 Oct 2026), so postedWithinDays defaults to 1 here. locations, experience, salary, job types and maxJobs still apply; the per-keyword cap does not. Combine with Only new jobs since the last run for a daily feed of every new job. You can also put * in the keywords.
locationsarrayOptional. Cities as foundit lists them: Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi (covers Delhi NCR: Gurugram, Noida), Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Remote. Several cities = any of them. Applied by the site, then checked on each job. Leave empty for all of India.
minExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range reaches at least this many years (0-30). From 1 upwards this also excludes jobs that do not state an experience range; 0 keeps them.
maxExperienceintegerOnly jobs whose experience range starts at or below this many years (0-30). 0 or 1 is a good fresher filter.
postedWithinDaysintegerOnly jobs posted or refreshed in the last N days (1-365), e.g. 1 with a daily schedule or 7 for a weekly report. Applied by the site and checked again on each job. Leave empty for all open jobs.
jobTypesarrayOptional. Any of Permanent Job, Contract Job, Work From Home, Internship, Temporary. Several values = any of them. Leave empty for all types.
minSalaryLpaintegerOnly jobs whose disclosed annual salary range reaches at least this many lakh INR, e.g. 10 = 10 LPA = 1,000,000 INR. Most foundit jobs do not disclose pay and are excluded when this is set.
maxSalaryLpaintegerOnly jobs whose disclosed annual salary range starts at or below this many lakh INR. Jobs without a disclosed salary are excluded when this is set.
includeDescriptionbooleanOn (default): one extra request per job adds the full description (HTML and plain text), the company profile, skills with the site's own tags, view count and exact city/state/coordinates. The price per job is the same either way. Off: listing fields only, about twice as fast, enough for counting jobs or sizing a market.
sortstringnewest (default): newest postings first, best for feeds and schedules. relevance: the site's own ranking, best when you only take the first few dozen jobs of a broad keyword.
maxJobsPerQueryintegerStop a keyword after this many new jobs (default 50). Cost: $0.0008 per job with its description, so 50 jobs = $0.04. Raise it for full exports: data analyst alone has about 1,200 open jobs and the site serves 100 per page.
maxJobsintegerHard cap on saved jobs for the whole run across all keywords (0 = no cap).
onlyNewSinceLastRunbooleanOn: deliver only jobs that an earlier run with the same stateName has not already delivered, and skip the rest without charging. If postedWithinDays is empty it is set to 3 so each run stays small. Off (default): return every matching job.
stateNamestringOptional name for this search's memory when onlyNewSinceLastRun is on, e.g. analyst-bangalore-daily. Leave empty to derive it from the keywords, cities and filters. Use a new key to start over.
skipJobIdsarrayArray of job IDs you already have (the id field from earlier runs), e.g. ["69495391", "69497219"]. They are skipped before any detail fetch and never charged. Large arrays are fine.

Price
$0.0008 per job ($0.80 per 1,000); $0.001 per run. List prices for Apify Free and Starter plans; Scale and Business plans pay 15% to 30% less.
EventPricePer 1,000Charged when
Job$0.0008$0.80One job with its full description: title, company, salary, experience, skills, locations, posted date, apply link.
Actor Start$0.001Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
Worked example: the input above, capped at 50 jobs, costs at most $0.041. Apify's free plan includes $5 of usage a month, about 6,250 jobs; the Actor's own compute is included in the per-record price, and records skipped by filters, de-duplication or only-new mode are not charged.

What it is not for
Naukri/LinkedIn/Indeed (not covered); senior management and MBA roles (IIMJobs has deeper coverage). The data belongs to its publisher; the Actor reads public pages and endpoints and leaves out personal contact details.

Questions buyers ask
How much does it cost to scrape foundit?
$0.0008 per job with its full description plus $0.001 per run, so 100 jobs cost about $0.08 and a 50-jobs-a-day feed about $1.25 a month.
Is there an official foundit API?
No public one. This Actor reads the JSON that the foundit.in website itself loads and exposes it as a REST API with schedules, webhooks and only-new-jobs runs.
Does it return the full job description?
Yes, as HTML and plain text, plus skills, industries, functions, applicant and view counts, salary band when disclosed, the company profile and the direct apply URL.
Why are so many salaries and experience ranges null?
Most postings on foundit are syndicated from employers' career sites without a salary or stated experience band. When the recruiter hides a salary the site does too, and the Actor keeps it hidden (salaryHidden: true). Filter on salaryHidden: false and non-null salaryMinLpa for benchmarking.
Is foundit the same as Monster India?
Yes. Monster India was renamed foundit in 2022; the site is foundit.in and the data is the same board.
Does it cover foundit Gulf, Singapore, Malaysia or Indonesia?
Not yet; this Actor covers foundit.in (India, including remote and the occasional overseas posting listed there). Open an issue if you need another region.
Why does a city return remote jobs only?
foundit answers an unknown city name with its remote jobs. The Actor drops those rows, charges nothing and tells you in the status message; use the spelling foundit uses (Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Remote).
Do I need a proxy or login?
No.

Alternatives, honestly
OptionWhat it gives youWhere it falls short for this job
foundit.in websiteSearch for a visitorNo export; syndicated apply links are one click at a time
Naukri, LinkedIn or Indeed ActorsLarger boardsDifferent coverage; this API reads foundit only
Other foundit Actors on Apify StoreSame boardCompare salary-band handling, apply-URL resolution and price per 1,000

Published by Daemon Data (data_daemon on Apify Store). Prices, fields and example pages on this page were read from the live Apify listing on 2026-10-29; the listing is the canonical description of the Actor.

# Instahyre startup tech jobs as JSON API | Daemon Data

Source: https://datadmon.github.io/actors/instahyre-jobs-scraper/

Instahyre startup tech jobs as JSON API

Instahyre Jobs Scraper is a pay-per-record Apify Actor by Daemon Data that returns India tech jobs from product companies and startups by skill, city, experience and company size, full descriptions included as JSON, CSV or Excel. It costs $0.0008 per job with the default options ($0.80 per 1,000); no login to the source site, no proxy, no browser, and the same input runs from the Apify console, one REST call, Python, Node.js, n8n or an AI assistant through MCP.

Daemon Data Instahyre Jobs Scraper on Apify   Listing as plain text

Checked on 21 Oct 2026
python matched 4,300 open Instahyre jobs (2,600 in Bangalore), react 1,600, data science 8,000 (title and skill-tag matching is broad), devops work-from-home 134. A 50-job run with descriptions takes well under a minute on the Apify platform and costs $0.04 plus the $0.001 start fee.

Job aggregators and HR-tech productsInstahyre as a source with stable job IDs (dedupKey), full JD text, de-duplication across keywords and runs, and an API you can call on a schedule. Same conventions as the IIMJobs, Hirist and Foundit Actors by the same publisher.
B2B sales and lead generationA company hiring five backend engineers is buying cloud, tooling and services. Each row carries the company name, size, tagline, website and logo.
Workforce and market analystsDemand by skill, city, experience band and company size over time; share of remote roles; which skills large companies ask for versus startups.
